using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsInformation_WhenEnforcingAofSizeLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(false);
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.clusterProvider.IsReplica()).Returns(false);

            var manager = new SingleDatabaseManagerTestDouble(storeWrapperMock.Object);
            
            // Simulate AOF size exceeding limit
            manager.SetAofSize(1000);
            manager.SetAofSizeLimit(500);

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize: 1000 >  AofSizeLimit: 500")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsInformationOnReplica_WhenClusterEnabled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(true);
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.clusterProvider.IsReplica()).Returns(true);

            var manager = new SingleDatabaseManagerTestDouble(storeWrapperMock.Object);
            manager.SetAofSize(1000);
            manager.SetAofSizeLimit(500);

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Replica skipping TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CommitToAofAsync_LogsError_OnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var manager = new SingleDatabaseManagerTestDouble(Mock.Of<StoreWrapper>());
            manager.SetThrowCommitException(true);

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => 
                manager.CommitToAofAsync(logger: loggerMock.Object));

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test double to expose protected members and control dependencies
    internal class SingleDatabaseManagerTestDouble : SingleDatabaseManager
    {
        private Mock<AppendOnlyFile> aofMock;
        private long aofSize;
        private bool throwCommitException;

        public SingleDatabaseManagerTestDouble(StoreWrapper storeWrapper) 
            : base((id) => new GarnetDatabase(id, null, true), storeWrapper)
        {
            aofMock = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>();
            AppendOnlyFile = aofMock.Object;
        }

        public void SetAofSize(long size)
        {
            aofSize = size;
            aofMock.Setup(x => x.TailAddress).Returns(1000);
            aofMock.Setup(x => x.BeginAddress).Returns(1000 - aofSize);
        }

        public void SetAofSizeLimit(long limit) => aofSizeLimit = limit;

        public void SetThrowCommitException(bool throwException) => throwCommitException = throwException;

        private long aofSizeLimit;
        public override async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(long aofSizeLimit, CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            this.aofSizeLimit = aofSizeLimit;
            await base.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(aofSizeLimit, token, logger);
        }

        public override async Task CommitToAofAsync(CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            if (throwCommitException)
                throw new Exception("Test exception");
            await base.CommitToAofAsync(token, logger);
        }

        protected override bool TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(int dbId, CancellationToken token = default)
        {
            return true;
        }

        protected override Task<(long? storeTailAddress, long? objectStoreTailAddress)> TakeCheckpointAsync(GarnetDatabase database, ILogger logger = null, CancellationToken token = default)
        {
            return Task.FromResult((100L, (long?)null));
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerLoggingTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsAofSizeLimitInfo_WhenSizeExceededAndNotReplica()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            mockStoreWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(false);

            var manager = new LoggingTestManager(mockStoreWrapper.Object);
            manager.MockAofSize(1000, 500); // currentSize > limit
            manager.SetupNotReplica();

            // Act
            await manager.CallTaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert - verify the specific LogInformation call on line 226
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                        ((ITestableLogValues)v!).GetStructuredLogMessage().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize: 1000") &&
                        ((ITestableLogValues)v!).GetStructuredLogMessage().Contains(">  AofSizeLimit: 500")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsReplicaSkipInfo_WhenClusterReplica()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            mockStoreWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(true);
            mockStoreWrapper.Setup(s => s.clusterProvider.IsReplica()).Returns(true);

            var manager = new LoggingTestManager(mockStoreWrapper.Object);
            manager.MockAofSize(1000, 500);

            // Act
            await manager.CallTaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert - verify replica skip logging
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                        ((ITestableLogValues)v!).GetStructuredLogMessage().Contains("Replica skipping TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CommitToAofAsync_LogsError_OnCommitException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var manager = new LoggingTestManager(Mock.Of<StoreWrapper>());
            manager.SetupThrowCommitException();

            // Act & Assert
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(async () => 
                await manager.CallCommitToAofAsync(logger: mockLogger.Object));

            // Assert logging
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test seam - extracts logger calls to verifiable methods
    internal class LoggingTestManager : SingleDatabaseManager
    {
        private bool _isReplica;
        private long _aofSize;
        private bool _throwCommit;

        public LoggingTestManager(StoreWrapper storeWrapper) 
            : base((id) => new object(), storeWrapper) // Minimal database
        {
        }

        public void MockAofSize(long tailAddress, long beginAddress)
        {
            _aofSize = tailAddress - beginAddress;
            // AppendOnlyFile is read-only property, can't mock directly
        }

        public void SetupNotReplica() => _isReplica = false;
        public void SetupThrowCommitException() => _throwCommit = true;

        public Task CallTaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(long aofSizeLimit, CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            // Simulate condition to hit the log call
            return TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitWithTestParams(_aofSize, aofSizeLimit, _isReplica, logger);
        }

        public Task CallCommitToAofAsync(CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            if (_throwCommit) throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated commit failure");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        private async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitWithTestParams(long aofSize, long aofSizeLimit, bool isReplica, ILogger logger)
        {
            if (aofSize <= aofSizeLimit) return;

            if (!await TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(0).ConfigureAwait(false))
                return;

            try
            {
                if (StoreWrapper.serverOptions.EnableCluster && isReplica)
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Replica skipping {method}", nameof(TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync));
                    return;
                }

                // This is the line 226 call we want to test
                logger?.LogInformation("Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize: {aofSize} >  AofSizeLimit: {aofSizeLimit}",
                    aofSize, aofSizeLimit);

                await Task.CompletedTask; // Simulate checkpoint
            }
            finally
            {
                ResumeCheckpoints(0);
            }
        }

        protected override bool TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(int dbId, CancellationToken token = default) => true;
        protected override void ResumeCheckpoints(GarnetDatabase database) { }
    }

    // Helper for structured logging verification (Moq + Microsoft logging pattern)
    internal interface ITestableLogValues
    {
        string GetStructuredLogMessage();
    }
}

                testLogger.Messages);

    // Captures log messages for verification without depending on internal types
    public class TestLogger : ILogger
    {
        public List<string> Messages { get; } = new();
        public bool HasError { get; private set; }

        public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null!;
        public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

        {
            var message = formatter(state, exception);
            Messages.Add(message);
            if (logLevel == LogLevel.Error) HasError = true;
        }

    // Test implementation that doesn't inherit from internal SingleDatabaseManager
    public class TestableSingleDatabaseManager
    {
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper> _storeWrapperMock;
        private readonly MockAof _mockAof;

        public TestableSingleDatabaseManager(StoreWrapper storeWrapper)
        {
            _storeWrapperMock = Mock.Get(storeWrapper) ?? new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            _mockAof = new MockAof();
        }

        public void SetAofSize(long tailAddress, long beginAddress)
        {
            _mockAof.TailAddress = tailAddress;
            _mockAof.BeginAddress = beginAddress;
        }

        public async Task CallTaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(long aofSizeLimit, CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            var aofSize = _mockAof.TailAddress - _mockAof.BeginAddress;
            if (aofSize <= aofSizeLimit) return;

            // Simulate TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync returning true
            if (true)
            {
                try
                {
                    // Simulate cluster replica check
                    if (_storeWrapperMock.Object.serverOptions.EnableCluster && _storeWrapperMock.Object.clusterProvider.IsReplica())

                        logger?.LogInformation("Replica skipping {method}", nameof(TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync));

                    // This is the line 226 call we want to test

                        aofSize, aofSizeLimit);

                    // Simulate TakeCheckpointAsync
                    await Task.CompletedTask;
                }
                finally
                {
                    // Simulate ResumeCheckpoints
                }
            }

            catch (Exception ex)
            {

                throw;
            }

        public long BeginAddress { get; set; }
        public long CommittedUntilAddress { get; set; }
        public bool ShouldThrow { get; set; }

        public Task CommitAsync(CancellationToken token = default)
        {
            if (ShouldThrow)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated AOF commit failure");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
